seed_preparation: The initial selector script chose __PAGEZERO (file size zero) as image base, so its expected-count assertion stopped before writing the seed file. The fixed script selects the file-backed offset-zero segment and validates all source bytes.
initial_mcp_attempt: The recorder had already started after the shell preflight failed. open_binary returned configuration error for the absent seed file; six dependent queries returned no-active-target errors. Corrected preparation creates the file before the new open. These are orchestration errors, not REA+ defects.
